overviewParagraphs: Siam Country Club Old Course is Thai golf's spiritual home — founded in 1971, it is the oldest golf club in the country and carries with it a weight of history and prestige that no other Thai course can claim. Since 2006, it has served as the permanent home of the Honda LPGA Thailand, hosting the world's top women professionals on its classically conditioned parkland layout every season.

The Old Course is a traditional design of great dignity — mature trees line every fairway, the greens are consistently among the best-paced in the region, and the overall playing experience carries an unhurried, club-like atmosphere that the newer resort courses struggle to replicate. It is a course where golf history is tangible.

For discerning golfers who want to walk the same fairways as world-ranked LPGA professionals and connect with the deep roots of Thai golf, Siam Country Club Old Course is an essential experience. AGS includes it regularly on Pattaya and Bangkok-extension golf programs.

curatorBriefHtml: Siam Country Club (Old Course) is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Pattaya, Thailand, crafted by Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) (2007) and stretching to 6,990 Yards across a classic parkland, mature trees environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its historic lpga tournament greens (Lightning fast putting surfaces) and strategic bunkering & mature tree line (Demanding driving accuracy).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Siam Country Club (Old Course) (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its world-class caddie training & line reading (Tour-grade green readers), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Pattaya golf tour by AGS, Siam Country Club (Old Course) provides a distinct architectural test by Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Siam Country Club (Old Course)?
faqs.a: Siam Country Club (Old Course) in Pattaya, Thailand is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) (opened 2007), measuring 6,990 Yards within a classic parkland, mature trees setting. It is particularly noted for historic lpga tournament greens (Lightning fast putting surfaces).

Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (world-class caddie training & line reading (Tour-grade green readers)), and private VIP transfers from your Pattaya hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Siam Country Club (Old Course)?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Siam Country Club (Old Course)'s strategic bunkering & mature tree line (Demanding driving accuracy) alongside historic lpga tournament greens (Lightning fast putting surfaces). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.
